job.job_description:
Job Title: AI Engineer Agentic AI

Experience: 3–5 Years
Location: Pune, Maharashtra
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative AI Engineer specializing in Agentic AI to design, develop, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making, task execution, and workflow orchestration. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agent frameworks, and end-to-end AI solution development.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop Agentic AI systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, and task execution.
Build and deploy AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies.
Develop and integrate AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Claude, or open-source models.
Create multi-agent systems for business process automation and intelligent workflow management.
Develop APIs and integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications and databases.
Optimize AI models for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Implement prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector database solutions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and deliver AI-driven business solutions.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve deployed AI applications.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in Agentic AI, Generative AI, and machine learning technologies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Generative AI development.
Strong experience in Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML libraries.
Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and RAG architectures.
Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, or FAISS.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and system integration.
Experience with Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in developing multi-agent AI systems and autonomous workflows.
Knowledge of MLOps and AI model deployment strategies.
Experience with enterprise AI implementations and chatbot development.
Relevant certifications in AI, Machine Learning, or Cloud technologies will be an added advantage.

Key Competencies

Agentic AI Development
Generative AI & LLMs
Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking
Innovation & Continuous Learning
Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
Solution Architecture & System Design
